title: Upload BG values to Nightscout after switching from BYOD to xdrip
symptom: After switching from BYOD app to xDrip as BG source, BG values are no longer uploaded to Nightscout when AndroidAPS is configured to upload. Other data like SMBs upload fine, but no BG values appear.
cause: AAPS does not upload BG data to Nightscout when xDrip is selected as the BG source.
fix: Configure xDrip to upload BG data to Nightscout, or use BYODA as BG source for AndroidAPS and disable xDrip's NS upload to avoid duplicates.
evidence_quote: AAPS doesn't upload BG data to NS when xDrip bg source is selected
